title: 4D-CityGML city declaration (4dcitygml.json)
description: The one owner of the declaration's shape. Read by scripts/city_declaration.py; checked by the schema subset of scripts/provenance_manifest.validate. Groups: identity (id, name, repo), dialect (dialect, building_id, data_dirs, crs), presentation (lang, map, logo, attribution, license, country), versions (tools, min_hub).

id.description: Identity: the city's short name, lower case (for example tokyo-station).

name.description: Identity: the city's display name per language (en, ja, de, ...).

repo.description: Identity: the city repository on GitHub, owner/name.

building_id.description: Dialect: the city's stable building ID (Exchange Contract A2). type: uro:buildingID (i-UR), gml:id, core:externalReference (the object name of the first external reference, such as an ALKIS identifier), or gen:<name> (a generic string attribute). Absent: the dialect pack's rule (plateau: uro:buildingID), else gml:id. invalid_values: values that are no ID (the building then falls back to its gml:id).

data_dirs.description: Dialect: the folders, relative to the repository root, that hold the city's data.

dialect.description: Dialect: the dialect pack the city's data follows (plateau: PLATEAU, i-UR). The pack brings the default building_id and crs (the city may override both), detects and checks the i-UR edition per file, and enables its own kinds. Absent: plain CityGML.

crs.description: Dialect: the CRS the data is written in, EPSG:<code>. Absent: the dialect pack's default (plateau: EPSG:6697), else none. Missing or unknown: no map and no 3D preview.

lang.description: Presentation: the repository's working language (BCP 47), for PR texts and CI comments. Absent: en.

map.description: Presentation: the editors' map. tiles: osm or gsi; center: [lat, lon]; zoom 0-22.

logo.description: Presentation: a raster image in the repository, relative path (png, jpg, jpeg, webp; the theme loader's list).

attribution.description: Presentation: the data source attribution the license requires.

license.description: Presentation: the data license (an SPDX id where one exists).

tools.description: Versions: the 4dcitygml/tools commit the city's CI runs, a commit a tools-v release tag points to (A11). Its tag is resolved when shown, not stored.

min_hub.description: Versions: the oldest editing-tools release the city accepts proposals from.
